PRACTICE CASE / SALES OPERATIONS ENABLEMENT

Making commercial activity visible and coordinated

Brand & Sales Operation Manager · January 2024–Present

01 / BUSINESS NEED

Connect the moving parts

Nationwide commercial execution brings together sales planning, incentives, distribution, logistics and marketing investment. These functions need shared performance visibility and coordination.

02 / MY CONTRIBUTION

Coordinate and track

  • Led sales operations across planning, incentives, distribution, applications and logistics.
  • Developed dashboards and reports to track sales trends, ROI and brand performance.
  • Aligned Brand, Sales, Factory and Supply Chain teams; oversaw budgets, agencies and vendors.

03 / DELIVERED

Decision support in practice

Business dashboards and reports supported data-driven decisions and ROI tracking, alongside coordinated sales operations and product-availability planning.
